title: Accuracy Orchestra: Golden-families harness for quant calibration and nondeterministic drift detection
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Overview: Build a reusable, automated validation harness that validates FP8/INT8 quantized model builds against curated 'golden families' of prompts and expected outputs. The harness (Accuracy Orchestra) will be used by calibration jobs, CI canaries, and runtime rollout gates. Goals: 1) Provide statistical, explainable pass/fail gates for quant variants (FP8/INT8) across multiple workload axes (assistant chat, instruction-following, code, summarization). 2) Detect nondeterministic drift and noisy regressions introduced by calibration or kernel changes. 3) Integrate into rollout pipelines to block or auto-rollback failing model variants. Scope: golden prompt families, perturbation generators, metric suite (embedding-cosine, edit-distance, token-shift), thresholding strategy, telemetry + dashboards, and CI/rollout automation. Out of scope for this ticket: migrating legacy per-model golden sets; that will be a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Golden families covering at least 6 workload axes are defined and versioned in the golden corpus store.

Validation harness can accept calibration outputs (FP8/INT8 artifacts) and produce a deterministic report with metrics and a pass/fail decision within 20 minutes for a medium-size model (<=7B) on standard CI runner.

Pass/fail gates implemented: median embedding cosine >= 0.985 across dialogue goldens AND 95th-percentile token-edit-distance <= 4 for instruction-following families. Thresholds are configurable per-family.
Integration completed for canary rollout: failing harness run triggers automatic halt of rollout and creates a rollback label with linked run artifacts.
Telemetry signals (per-family metric distributions and historical trend) available in Console dashboard and an alert (Slack + PagerDuty) fires when regression exceeds configured tolerance window.
At least two sample calibration jobs (one FP8, one INT8) have been run and validated, with documented results and a follow-up triage note if failings observed.
steps: Design golden-family taxonomy and sampling rules (seed prompts, paraphrase variants, edge-case scaffolds).
Implement perturbation generators (typos, long-context truncation, instruction inversion) and a runner that applies them deterministically with seeded RNG.
Define metric library: embedding-cosine (use sentence-transformer baseline), normalized token edit distance, token-shift distribution, top-k probability KL, and response-length-preservation metrics.
Create per-family threshold configuration with fallback harmonization rules and store in config service (versioned).

Wire harness into calibration pipeline: data fetch -> quantized build import -> run generation -> compute metrics -> produce JSON report and decision -> emit telemetry and webhook for rollout service.
Implement CI job template and GitHub Action for running harness as part of PR and release pipelines.
Create Console dashboard and alerting rules; write runbook for triage.
comments: 2025-11-06 Marcus Lee: Spike complete. Baseline runner produces deterministic outputs for seed=42; embedding-cosine computed with legacy-sim model. Observed variance on long-context summarization families—need to tune sampling and tokenization alignment.

2025-11-09 Aisha Khan: Decided to use sentence-transformers-small as a stable embedding baseline to reduce variance vs the model under test. Added a task to normalize tokenizers across golden generation and model evaluation.

2025-11-12 Marcus Lee: Implemented perturbation generator. Edge-case: instruction inversion increases false positives on code-generation family; added family-specific tolerance and flagged for further labeling improvements.
2025-11-15 PM review (Sofia Martin): Request to expose per-family thresholds in Console UI for product owners; added to scope (lightweight edit form + audit log).

2025-11-18 QA (Diego Ruiz): Ran FP8 run on model-x-7b-int8-candidate; harness reported a marginal fail (median embedding cosine 0.983 vs threshold 0.985) on the 'multi-turn-reasoning' family. Created sub-issue ENG-97655 to triage calibration config and ENG-97656 for golden set augmentation.
notes: Trade-offs: embedding-based similarity is robust across paraphrases but can mask token-level artifacts important for code generation; therefore dual gating (embedding + token-edit) is used.

Calibration workflow: harness will be invoked post-calibration with the final scale factors. If the harness fails, pipeline marks the build 'blocked' and triggers an auto-rollback path where available.
Sampling rules: stratified sampling across prompt length percentiles (short/medium/long) and temperature settings to capture stochastic behavior.
Observability: each run emits per-prompt metric vectors and delta vs last-known-good. We will keep 30 days of raw runs for drift analysis.
